title: The Potters' Studio Gas Reduction Firing Service
summary: Drop off bisqued or glazed work at the studio's main entrance (10am–5pm, 7 days a week) for cone 10 gas reduction firing. Turnaround is up to 3 weeks. Members pay $28.05 per cubic foot; non-members $63.00 per cubic foot (or $52.50 with personal glazes). $50 minimum charge applies.
cost_text: Members: $28.05 per cubic foot; Contract firers (non-members): $63.00 per cubic foot using studio glazes or $52.50 per cubic foot using personal cone 10 glazes. $50 minimum charge.
bring: Bisqued or glazed work; personal cone 10 glazes optional
how_to_join: Bring work to the studio's main entrance at 724 Camelia Street (4th Street side), Berkeley CA 94710, during regular hours 10am–5pm daily. Payment due at drop-off.
evidence_sentence: The studio fires bisqued work in a cone 10 gas kiln under medium reduction on a rolling basis for $63–$52.50 per cubic foot.
evidence_quote: We offer low, mid, and high-fire services in our electric and cone 10 gas kilns on a contract basis.
source_quote: We offer low, mid, and high-fire services in our electric and cone 10 gas kilns on a contract basis. No reservations necessary – just bring in your work to our main entrance on 4th Street during regular daytime staff hours (7 days a week, 10am to 5pm).
pay_text: Payment due at time of drop-off. Members: $28.05/cu ft; non-members: $63.00/cu ft (studio glazes) or $52.50/cu ft (personal glazes). $50 minimum charge.
